concerns.text: Task T016 claims to satisfy FR‑005 by applying FDR correction to p‑values derived from permutation‑importance null distributions. The specification (FR‑005) explicitly requires FDR correction of the *coefficient* p‑values from the Elastic Net model, not permutation‑importance scores. This constitutes a semantic weakening of FR‑005 (and the related SC‑002) because the required statistical evidence (adjusted coefficient p‑values) is never produced or verified.

Since the required coefficient p‑values are omitted, SC‑002 (which expects an FDR‑adjusted p‑value for the top predictive feature) cannot be satisfied. The current verification only checks that a dictionary with 30 keys exists, not that the adjusted p‑values correspond to model coefficients.
